question: Who was Steve Hotte meeting with in California when he replied from his handheld on Oct 22?

steps.text: Plan: find Steve Hotte's Oct 22 email sent from a handheld, then read it to see who he was meeting in California.

steps.arguments: {"query": "Steve Hotte California meeting sent from handheld"}
steps.summary: 10 results, 10 of them people's own mail

answer:
He was meeting with Pickering. The Oct 22, 2001 email from steve.hotte@enron.com says: "I'll get you one. I'm replying real-time, using my Blackberry while in a meeting in California with Pickering."

The email names only "Pickering", with no first name. Another Oct 22 email in the mailbox is from mark.pickering@enron.com. It discusses an organizational announcement that moves Hotte into a new CIO role. That makes Mark Pickering the likely person, but the Hotte email doesn't say so outright. I didn't open the full Hotte email to check its recipients.
